### Life Is Better Together
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/life-is-better-together-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Acts 2:42
Points:
- Active involvement in a local church provides meaningful connection that counters modern isolation and loneliness.
- Gathering with the body of Christ was a non-negotiable priority for early believers, not an occasional convenience.
- The disciples overcame historic tensions and differences by staying focused on Christ rather than personal preferences.
- Authentic Christian fellowship extended beyond structured services into everyday life, shared meals, and hospitality.

### Snapshot of the Early Church
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/snapshot-of-the-early-church
Passage: Acts 2:42
Points:
- The earliest believers prioritized sound doctrine, learning how Jesus fulfilled the Old Testament Scriptures.
- Fellowship involves the simple, biblical joy of gathering and building one another up in everyday life.
- Breaking bread highlights the covenant privilege of sharing communion at the Lord's Table.
- Gathering for corporate prayer strengthens personal communion with God and deepens mutual care.
